source_audit.granularity: Project ID plus Building ID with address, BBL/BIN, coordinates, and unit counts.
source_audit.reliability: strong for HPD housing-production administrative completion records

source_audit.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings (DOB) via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: NYC Open Data public dataset under NYC Open Data/NYC.gov terms; retain publisher attribution and row-level API query. Terms: https://www.nyc.gov/home/terms-of-use.page
source_audit.coverage_years: DOB NOW CO records from March 2021 onward; this round sampled final CO rows issued 2024-2026.
source_audit.granularity: Application number / CO number / job filing / BIN / BBL / address.
source_audit.reliability: strong for legal occupancy certificate issuance/status
source_audit.required_caveats: CO issuance is legal occupancy/use evidence, not lease-up, resident move-in, architectural merit, or outcome evidence.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use sparingly for high-unit final CO candidates and cross-link to HPD/project pages where possible.

source_audit.coverage_years: Project tracking since the late 1970s; metadata current version noted as 20260209.
source_audit.granularity: Project ID with action numbers, status, applicant, borough/community district, and milestone dates.
source_audit.reliability: strong for land-use/application administrative milestones; weak for physical construction evidence
source_audit.required_caveats: ZAP completion/approval does not prove construction start, construction completion, occupancy, design delivery, or public access.

source_audit.granularity: Project ID with phase, design start, budget forecast, and forecast completion.

source_audit.granularity: Facility/program site snapshot, not a dated change event.
source_audit.reliability: strong for current facility inventory; not reliable as standalone change-date evidence
